scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/domain.test.cjs test/capitulo10.test.cjs test/adapter.capitulo10.test.cjs
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 integration/firestore.test.cjs integration/capitulo10.firestore.test.cjs integration/revision.regression.test.cjs integration/cierre.cn-renzo.test.cjs integration/cierre.ac02.test.cjs integration/cierre.matchmaking.test.cjs

scripts.test:integration:coverage: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --experimental-test-coverage integration/firestore.test.cjs integration/capitulo10.firestore.test.cjs integration/revision.regression.test.cjs integration/cierre.cn-renzo.test.cjs integration/cierre.ac02.test.cjs integration/cierre.matchmaking.test.cjs
